culprit_citations.quoted_text: Chilton - First Lien Senior Secured Loan - Delayed Draw; index, spread, interest rate, and principal are all shown as dashes; cost is (21) and market value is (103).

findings.detail: X02 treats an unfunded delayed-draw commitment as funded private credit requiring a current interest rate, although the filing intentionally reports no rate or principal.

rationale: The raw schedule decides the issue: the cited delayed-draw row has no funded principal and the filer reports dashes for index, spread, and interest rate, alongside negative cost and fair value consistent with an unfunded commitment or liability exposure. Missing interest_rate and basis_spread are therefore source-faithful, and the X02 warning arises from applying the funded-loan rate requirement to this commitment subtype.
